item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: The chief of the U.S. Ski Team says Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the United States a week after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins NASCAR Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: 3 LAPD officers injured in crash at end of chase in Reseda
item.description: Three LAPD officers were injured after two cruisers crashed into each other at the end of a chase near the Reseda-Northridge border

item.title: SoCal man wins $2 million from scratcher sold in Santa Clarita; $1 million also won in Hawthorne
item.description: Two Southern California residents are now millionaires after winning tickets were sold in Santa Clarita and Hawthorne last week.

item.title: Arrest made after deadly shooting at North Hollywood apartment complex, police say
item.description: One person has been arrested after a shooting overnight at an apartment complex in North Hollywood left a man in his 20s dead.

item.title: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez released from prison after 2022 shooting
item.description: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez was released from prison following a 2022 shooting, the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation confirmed on Sunday. Velasquez was in prison for attempted murder of a man charged with molesting Velasquez's son.

item.title: 2 people in critical condition after small plane crashes on residential road in Camarillo
item.description: Two people are severely injured after a small plane crashed in Camarillo on Sunday evening. AIR7 video shows the plane upside down next to a drainage ditch.

item.title: Timeline of powerful storms headed to Southern California
item.description: Several powerful storms will begin moving into Southern California on Monday, bringing four straight days of rain. We're timing out when they'll arrive.

item.title: 97-year-old Palisades Fire victim may sue California FAIR plan for barely covering remediation costs
item.description: A 97-year-old Palisades resident paid over $300,000 out of pocket to move back into her home, which miraculously survived the fire. Her family says the California FAIR plan only provided $38,000 to remediate the inside.
